goal: Prepare the hacheong 2.0.0 release candidate: version metadata and a timeless major-version rule, checked on Python 3.11
brief: Prepare hacheong 2.0.0 as a release candidate: set exactly five version values to 2.0.0 (plugin.json version, .claude-plugin/plugin.json version, .codex-plugin/plugin.json version, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json metadata.version and its hacheong plugins[].version); keep all three engines.python at >=3.11; keep .agents/plugins/marketplace.json as it is (no version field there); turn README Versioning's pending 'planned 2.0' sentence into a timeless major-version rule, keeping the note that releases up to 1.12.1 had the old red gate. No runtime, test, AGENTS, skill or hostcall.py change; nothing published, tagged, installed or pushed. The self-checks run on Python 3.11.
checks:
import json
M=("plugin.json",".claude-plugin/plugin.json",".codex-plugin/plugin.json")
m=json.load(open(".claude-plugin/marketplace.json"))
v=[json.load(open(f))["version"] for f in M]+[m["metadata"]["version"]]+[p["version"] for p in m["plugins"] if p["name"]=="hacheong"]
e=[json.load(open(f))["engines"]["python"] for f in M]
t=open(".agents/plugins/marketplace.json").read(); a=json.loads(t)
assert v==["2.0.0"]*5, v
assert e==[">=3.11"]*3, e
assert a["name"]=="hacheong" and [p["name"] for p in a["plugins"]]==["hacheong"] and a["plugins"][0]["source"]=={"source":"local","path":"./"} and "version" not in t, a
print("versions", v, "python", e, "agents marketplace unchanged")

import json,os,re
slug=lambda h: re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 -]","",h.strip().lower()).replace(" ","-")
bad=[]
for md in ("README.md","AGENTS.md","CLAUDE.md","skills/hire/SKILL.md"):
    for t in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)\s]+)\)", open(md, encoding="utf-8").read()):
        if t.startswith(("http://","https://")): continue
        p,_,a=t.partition("#"); f=os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(md),p)) if p else md
        if not os.path.exists(f): bad.append((md,t)); continue
        if a and f.endswith(".md") and a not in {slug(h) for h in re.findall(r"^#+ (.+)$",open(f,encoding="utf-8").read(),re.M)}: bad.append((md,t))
for f in ("plugin.json",".claude-plugin/plugin.json",".codex-plugin/plugin.json"):
    d=json.load(open(f))
    for role,argv in d["roles"].items():
        bad += [(f,role,x) for x in argv if "{plugin:hacheong}/" in x and not os.path.exists(x.split("{plugin:hacheong}/")[1])]
c=json.load(open(".codex-plugin/plugin.json")); bad += [] if os.path.isdir(c["skills"]) else [("codex skills",c["skills"])]
bad += [] if os.path.isfile("skills/hire/SKILL.md") else [("skill missing",)]
bad += [] if os.path.isdir(json.load(open(".claude-plugin/marketplace.json"))["plugins"][0]["source"]) else [("marketplace source",)]
assert not bad, bad
print("links, anchors, role workers, skills and marketplace sources resolve")
